<thought>Based on the provided fragments—benzene (c1ccccc1), a carbonyl group (C(=O)O), and a chloromethyl group (CCl)—the most straightforward way to combine them into a single molecule is to attach the carbonyl group to the benzene ring and then attach the chloromethyl group via the oxygen of the carbonyl (forming an ester). This yields the SMILES string “c1ccccc1C(=O)OCCl”.</thought>
<final_answer>c1ccccc1C(=O)OCCl</final_answer>
